description: Human vs mouse KRT9 domain composition and rod conservation using the correct ortholog Q6RHW0
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re, pandas as pd
def rec(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()
def regions_of(r):
    s=r["sequence"]["value"]
    rod=[f for f in r["features"] if f["type"]=="Domain" and "IF rod" in f.get("description","")]
    st,en=rod[0]["location"]["start"]["value"], rod[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
    return s[:st-1], s[st-1:en], s[en:]

hu=rec("P35527"); mo=rec("Q6RHW0")
print("mouse:", mo["uniProtkbId"], mo["organism"]["scientificName"], "len", mo["sequence"]["length"])
h_head,h_rod,h_tail=regions_of(hu); m_head,m_rod,m_tail=regions_of(mo)

def frac(s,aa): return 100*sum(s.count(c) for c in aa)/len(s)
print(f"\n{'segment':<14}{'len':>6}{'Gly%':>8}{'Ser%':>8}{'Gly+Ser%':>10}{'charged%':>10}")
segs=[("human head",h_head),("mouse head",m_head),("human rod",h_rod),("mouse rod",m_rod),
      ("human tail",h_tail),("mouse tail",m_tail)]
for nm,s in segs:
    print(f"{nm:<14}{len(s):>6}{frac(s,'G'):>8.1f}{frac(s,'S'):>8.1f}{frac(s,'GS'):>10.1f}{frac(s,'DEKR'):>10.1f}")

print()
for nm,s in segs:
    loops=re.findall(r"G{3,}",s)
    print(f"{nm:<14} {len(loops):>3} Gly runs >=3, longest {max((len(x) for x in loops),default=0)}")

# per-region identity human vs mouse KRT9 using rod-anchored comparison (rods are same length? check)
print("\nrod lengths:", len(h_rod), len(m_rod))
ident = 100*sum(1 for a,b in zip(h_rod,m_rod) if a==b)/min(len(h_rod),len(m_rod))
print(f"ungapped rod identity human vs mouse KRT9: {ident:.1f}%")
# helix initiation motif (153-172 human) and termination motif (440-461)
him_h=hu["sequence"]["value"][152:172]; him_m=mo["sequence"]["value"]
# locate HIM in mouse by motif search
i=him_m.find("LNNRLASYLDKVR")
print("human HIM 153-172:", him_h)
# align rods positionally
htm_h=hu["sequence"]["value"][439:461]
print("human HTM 440-461:", htm_h)
print("mouse rod start   :", m_rod[:40])
print("human rod start   :", h_rod[:40])
print("mouse rod end     :", m_rod[-30:])
print("human rod end     :", h_rod[-30:])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.4))
labels=[s[0].replace(" ","\n") for s in segs]
g=[frac(s[1],'G') for s in segs]; se=[frac(s[1],'S') for s in segs]; ch=[frac(s[1],'DEKR') for s in segs]
x=np.arange(len(segs)); w=0.26
ax.bar(x-w,g,w,label="Gly",color="#3b6ea5"); ax.bar(x,se,w,label="Ser",color="#c0763a")
ax.bar(x+w,ch,w,label="charged (D, E, K, R)",color="#2f6f4e")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("percent of residues")
ax.set_title("KRT9 architecture: glycine-rich, uncharged end domains flank a charged alpha-helical rod")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
